title: Casinova Leaderboard Guide: How Rankings Are Calculated
excerpt: The Casinova Gaming leaderboard ranks the top 50 members by total VIP points, highest first. It is one all-time board: there are no daily, weekly or monthly resets and no prize attached to a position. Points come from card deposits, daily check-ins, the daily spin, completed game account requests and referrals.
content:
The Casinova Gaming leaderboard ranks the top 50 members by total VIP points, highest first. It is one all-time board: there are no daily, weekly or monthly resets and no prize attached to a position. Points come from card deposits, daily check-ins, the daily spin, completed game account requests and referrals.

What the leaderboard shows

The leaderboard page is public, so you can read it without logging in. It is a single table with four columns:

  • Rank. Position 1 to 50, ordered by VIP points from highest to lowest.
  • Player. A shortened version of the member's name (see below).
  • Tier. Bronze, Silver, Gold or Platinum.
  • VIP Points. The member's lifetime points total.

Only the top 50 accounts are listed. Suspended accounts are left off. The page is rebuilt roughly every two minutes, so a change in your points can take a couple of minutes to appear. If no rankings are available yet, the page shows "Rankings will appear soon" in place of the table.

How rankings are calculated

There is no separate leaderboard score. Your rank is your VIP points total compared with everyone else's. The same number decides your VIP tier, which is why the board also works as a quick way to see how far the next tier is in practice. These are the actions that add points:

ActionVIP points
Card deposit credited to your wallet1 point per dollar, rounded to the nearest whole point
Daily check-in on the Daily rewards page5 on the first day, 1 more for each consecutive day, up to 11 from day seven
Daily mission: spin the wheel, then claim5
Cash prize on the daily spin10 points per dollar won, so 10 to 100
Game account request completed by staff50
Friend signs up with your referral code10

The check-in streak follows the calendar day in UTC. Miss a day and the streak starts again at 5 points. Points do not expire and the board never resets, so the total only moves up.

How your name appears

The board never shows a full name or an email address. If your profile has a first and last name, it shows the first name and the initial of the last name, for example "Maria L.". If your profile has one name only, it shows the first letter followed by asterisks. If there is no name on the profile, it shows the first two characters of your email followed by asterisks. There is no opt-in step: any active account with enough points to reach the top 50 is listed automatically.

What the leaderboard is not

An older version of this guide described things the site does not have. To be clear:

  • No period boards. There is no daily, weekly or monthly board. One all-time table only.
  • No XP. The board counts VIP points. Casinova has no XP or level number; the XP and levels guide explains what exists instead.
  • No prize for placing. Finishing first, or in the top ten, pays nothing extra. The benefits come from your tier, not your rank.
  • No effect on games. Rank does not change the deposit match, the $5 to $500 load range or the redeem rules, and it has no influence on results inside a game.

How rank relates to VIP tiers

Because the board and the tiers use the same number, the tier column tells you roughly where the thresholds sit on the table: Bronze from 0 points, Silver from 500, Gold from 2,000 and Platinum from 5,000. What a tier changes is your referral share of a friend's first deposit (5%, 10%, 15%, 25%) and your daily spins (1, 2, 3, 3). The VIP tiers guide has the full table, and the VIP page shows your own points when you are logged in.

Sensible ways to move up

  1. Check in every day. Open Daily rewards in your dashboard and claim. A full week of consecutive check-ins is 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 points, 56 in total, and every day after that is 11 as long as the streak holds.
  2. Spin, then claim the mission. Take your daily spin, then go back to Daily rewards and claim the 5 mission points. A cash prize on the wheel adds 10 points per dollar on top. The daily spin guide lists the prizes.
  3. Refer people who will actually use the site. Each sign-up with your code is 10 points. The referral guide covers the code and the first-deposit share.
  4. Let deposits count, but do not deposit for rank. A $50 card deposit adds 50 points. That is a side effect of money you already planned to play with, not a reason to add more.

That last point matters. A leaderboard position has no cash value, and points earned by depositing more than you intended are expensive points. Set your budget first and treat rank as a by-product. If keeping up with the board starts to shape how much you spend, the responsible play page has tools and contacts.

FAQ

Do I need to opt in to appear on the leaderboard?

No. The board lists the 50 active accounts with the most VIP points automatically, with names shortened so no full name or email is shown.

Does the leaderboard reset?

No. It is a single all-time ranking by total VIP points. There are no daily, weekly or monthly boards.

Is there a prize for finishing first?

No. Rank itself pays nothing. The practical benefits, a higher referral share and more daily spins, come from your VIP tier.

Why am I not on the board?

Only the top 50 accounts by points are shown. Your own points total and the gap to the next tier are on the VIP page in your dashboard.

How quickly does the board update?

The page is refreshed about every two minutes, so new points can take a short while to show.

Create your free account and your points start counting from your first check-in.

title: Casinova Gaming: How the Platform Works, End to End
excerpt: Casinova Gaming is a sweepstakes gaming platform that puts one account and one wallet in front of eight third-party game apps, including Juwa, Game Vault and Vegas Sweeps. You deposit by card, load $5 to $500 into a game, and redeem from the game panel once the balance reaches 3x the load. It is not a licensed casino, and availability varies by jurisdiction.
content:
Casinova Gaming is a sweepstakes gaming platform that puts one account and one wallet in front of eight third-party game apps, including Juwa, Game Vault and Vegas Sweeps. You deposit by card, load $5 to $500 into a game, and redeem from the game panel once the balance reaches 3x the load. It is not a licensed casino, and availability varies by jurisdiction.

What "platform" means here

The games themselves are made by outside providers. Each one normally needs its own login and its own way of adding credits. Casinova sits in front of them: you hold one Casinova account, one wallet, and a panel for each game where you create a login, load credits, check the balance and submit a redeem. Your deposit history, VIP points and support messages stay in the same account no matter which game you open.

What is inside a Casinova account

  • A wallet. Funded by card through a payment partner. Checkout happens on the partner's page.
  • A panel per game. Create the game login, load, check balance and redeem from one screen.
  • A daily spin. A free wheel with prizes of $1, $2, $3, $4, $7 or $10, or nothing. Bronze members get 1 spin per 24 hours, Silver 2, Gold and Platinum 3. See the daily spin guide.
  • Daily rewards. A check-in that adds VIP points, with a streak that raises the daily amount.
  • VIP tiers. Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum at 0, 500, 2,000 and 5,000 points. Explained in the VIP tiers guide.
  • Referrals. A personal code. You receive 5% to 25% of a referred friend's first deposit, depending on your tier, plus 10 VIP points.
  • A leaderboard. The top 50 members by VIP points, on the public leaderboard page.
  • Support chat. A chat bubble on the site and a Messages inbox in the dashboard, available around the clock.
  • ID verification. An upload page for a government ID, required before any redeem.

How it works, end to end

  1. Create a free account and verify your email.
  2. Deposit by card. The deposit guide walks through checkout. Card is the only method. Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, Chime and crypto are not offered.
  3. Open a live game and create your game login from its panel. The login appears in the panel when it is ready.
  4. Load credits. Any whole-dollar amount from $5 to $500 per load. The deposit match is applied at this step. Details in how to load credits.
  5. Play in the provider's app or web player with the login from your panel.
  6. Redeem. When the in-game balance reaches 3x your load, submit a redeem from the same panel. You need an approved ID, and staff review every request. See how to redeem.

The money rules in one table

RuleWhat applies
Deposit methodCard only, through a payment partner
Deposit match100% on the first deposit, 50% on the second, none after
When the match is appliedWhen you load a game
Load size$5 minimum, $500 maximum, rounded to the nearest dollar
Redeem thresholdIn-game balance of at least 3x the load
Redeem cap8x the load
Redeem requirementsApproved government ID and a staff review

The same rules apply to every live game and every VIP tier. There is no payout-time promise: a redeem is finished when the review is finished.

Games you can load now

Eight games are live: Game Vault, Juwa, MR All In One, Cash Machine, Cash Frenzy, Vegas Sweeps, Gameroom and Mafia. Between them they cover slots, keno and fish shooters. If you are unsure where to start, the four-question guide narrows it down.

Six more titles are listed as coming soon and cannot be loaded yet: Orion Stars, Fire Kirin, Panda Master, Vblink, Milky Way and Ultrapanda. Their cards on the games page carry a "soon" badge. The coming-soon guide suggests the closest live game for each.

What the platform does not do

  • It does not set game outcomes. Results come from each provider's software and are based on chance. Casinova does not publish odds or RTP because the providers do not.
  • It does not offer promo codes, free credits or a no-deposit bonus. The deposit match and the daily spin are the offers.
  • It does not take payment outside card checkout. Anyone asking you to send money another way in Casinova's name is not Casinova.
  • It does not claim to be available everywhere. Sweepstakes rules differ by jurisdiction, and checking yours is your responsibility.

Play is for adults 18 and over. Decide what you can afford before you deposit, and use the responsible play page if it stops being fun.

FAQ

Is Casinova Gaming a casino?

No. It is a sweepstakes gaming platform, not a licensed casino. Availability varies by jurisdiction.

How do I deposit?

By card, through the payment partner's checkout page. No other payment method is offered.

Which games are available right now?

Game Vault, Juwa, MR All In One, Cash Machine, Cash Frenzy, Vegas Sweeps, Gameroom and Mafia. Games marked coming soon cannot be loaded yet.

What do I need before I can redeem?

An in-game balance of at least 3x your load and an approved government ID. Staff review each request, and total redeems are capped at 8x the load.

Do I need a separate wallet for each game?

No. One Casinova wallet funds every live game. Each game has its own login and balance once you load it.

Create your free account and look around the dashboard before you deposit anything.

title: Casinova Gaming Telegram and Support: How to Get Help
excerpt: Casinova Gaming has an official Telegram at t.me/casinovagaming, linked from the footer of every page, and it is where promotions and new guides are announced. Account support itself runs through the live chat on the site and the Messages inbox in your dashboard, 24/7. content:
Casinova Gaming has an official Telegram at t.me/casinovagaming, linked from the footer of every page, and it is where promotions and new guides are announced. Account support itself runs through the live chat on the site and the Messages inbox in your dashboard, 24/7. For anything about a deposit, a game login or a redeem, use the site chat, where staff can see your account.

What the Telegram is for

The Telegram link sits with the other social icons in the site footer. Casinova uses Telegram to post promotion alerts and links to new blog guides, so following it is a convenient way to hear about a new card on the promotions page without checking the site every day.

It is not connected to your account. Nothing you send on Telegram is attached to your wallet, your game panels or your ID status, and you do not need a Telegram account to use Casinova at all.

Where support actually happens

ChannelWho it is forUse it for
Chat bubble on the siteVisitors who are not logged inGeneral questions before you sign up
Chat and Messages in the dashboardLogged-in membersDeposits, game logins, loads, redeems, ID verification
TelegramAnyonePromotion alerts and new guides

The support page lists the same options along with common questions.

How the dashboard chat works

When you are logged in, the chat has two modes, shown as two tabs at the top of the window:

  • AI Assistant. The default. It answers common questions straight away, such as the load range or how redeem works.
  • Real Agent. Tap this tab to hand the conversation to a person. The chat shows a notice that an agent has been notified and will reply in the same window.

This is the real link between Casinova support and Telegram: when you message support and no agent is online on the site, the team receives an alert on their own internal Telegram so someone can pick it up. You do not need to do anything on Telegram for that to happen, and the reply arrives in the site chat, not on Telegram.

The Messages inbox also accepts attachments, so you can send a screenshot of what you are seeing. Your conversation history stays in the inbox, which gives you a written record if you need to refer back to it.

What to include so the first reply is useful

  1. The game. For example Juwa or Game Vault.
  2. What you did and when. "Loaded $20 at about 3 pm" is far more useful than "my load is missing".
  3. What the panel shows now. A screenshot of the game panel or your deposit history saves a round of questions.
  4. What you expected. One sentence is enough.

Many questions are answered faster by a guide than by a queue. For a deposit that has not appeared, read the card deposit guide. For a locked redeem, check ID verification and how to redeem first, because the usual causes are an ID still in review or a balance below 3x the load.

Staying safe on Telegram

Telegram makes it easy for anyone to create an account with a familiar name and logo. Treat every direct message that claims to be Casinova with suspicion, and keep these rules:

  • Use the link in the site footer. The official handle is t.me/casinovagaming. Do not trust a handle sent to you by a stranger.
  • Card checkout on the site is the only way to deposit. Casinova does not take Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, Chime or crypto, so a request to pay that way is not from Casinova.
  • Never share your password, a login code or your full card number in any chat.
  • Upload your ID only in the dashboard. The ID verification page is the place for it, not a Telegram chat.
  • Ignore offers of promo codes or free credits. Casinova has no promo codes and no free credits, so a message offering them is bait.

The guide to checking whether Casinova is legit covers what else you can verify yourself.

Does VIP tier change support?

The VIP page lists standard support at Bronze, priority support at Silver, 24/7 VIP support at Gold and a dedicated account manager at Platinum. All of it happens through the same site chat and Messages inbox. There is no separate Telegram line for higher tiers, and Casinova does not publish a response-time figure for any tier. The VIP tiers guide lists the thresholds.

If you are contacting support because play has become stressful or you want a break, say so directly, and see the responsible play page.

FAQ

Is Telegram the way to contact Casinova support?

No. Support runs through the live chat on the site and the Messages inbox in your dashboard. Telegram is used for promotion alerts and new guides.

Do I need a Telegram account to use Casinova?

No. Everything, including deposits, loads, redeems and support, works on the site without Telegram.

What is the official Casinova Telegram?

t.me/casinovagaming, which is the link behind the Telegram icon in the site footer.

Someone on Telegram asked me to pay by Cash App or crypto. Is that Casinova?

No. Deposits are by card through the checkout on the site and no other method is offered. Do not send money, and report the account to support through the site chat.

How do I reach a person instead of the AI assistant?

Log in, open the chat and tap the Real Agent tab. An agent is notified and replies in the same chat window.

Create your free account and you will find the chat in your dashboard from the first login.

title: Casinova Gaming vs Online Casinos: What Is the Difference?
excerpt: Casinova Gaming is a sweepstakes gaming platform, not a licensed online casino. A licensed casino holds a gambling license from a regulator and operates only where that license applies; Casinova holds no casino license, makes no claim about where it is legal, and its availability varies by jurisdiction. In practice the differences you will notice are how you pay, how you redeem and what information is published about the games.
content:
Casinova Gaming is a sweepstakes gaming platform, not a licensed online casino. A licensed casino holds a gambling license from a regulator and operates only where that license applies; Casinova holds no casino license, makes no claim about where it is legal, and its availability varies by jurisdiction. In practice the differences you will notice are how you pay, how you redeem and what information is published about the games.

Quick comparison

Casinova GamingLicensed online casino (in general)
Legal basisSweepstakes model, no casino licenseGambling license issued by a regulator
Where it operatesVaries by jurisdiction; you must check your ownOnly in places covered by its license
GamesThird-party apps such as Juwa and Game Vault, each with its own loginGames offered inside the casino's own site or app
Paying inCard only, through a payment partnerDepends on the operator
Bonus100% match on the first deposit, 50% on the second, none afterDepends on the operator
Getting money outRedeem from the game panel at 3x the load, capped at 8x, with ID and staff reviewWithdrawal under the operator's terms and its regulator's rules
Published odds or RTPNoneDepends on the regulator and the operator
Minimum age18+Set by the regulator

The right-hand column is deliberately general. Licensed casinos differ from one another and from one regulator to the next, and this page is not a guide to any of them.

The legal model is the real difference

A licensed online casino takes wagers under a license. The regulator that issued it decides where the casino can operate, what checks it must run and how complaints are handled. Casinova does not operate under that framework. It runs under a sweepstakes model, which is a different category, and it does not tell you that the model is permitted where you live. That is for you to confirm before you sign up.

Two posts go deeper on this: what sweepstakes games are and sweepstakes versus real-money gambling. Neither is legal advice, and neither is this page.

How the games differ

On Casinova you do not play inside the Casinova website. You create a login for a third-party game app from your dashboard, load credits into it from your wallet, and play in the provider's app or web player. Eight games are live, including Juwa, Game Vault, Vegas Sweeps and Cash Machine. The formats will look familiar if you have used a casino site: slots, keno and fish shooters. If the shooter format is new to you, start with what a fish table game is.

Each game holds its own balance. Credits loaded into Juwa stay in Juwa until you redeem them from the Juwa panel; they do not move across to another game.

How the money side differs

  • One payment method. Deposits are by card through a payment partner, and checkout happens on the partner's page. Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, Chime and crypto are not offered. The card deposit guide shows each step.
  • Loads have fixed limits. $5 minimum and $500 maximum per load, rounded to the nearest dollar.
  • The bonus is tied to deposit order. Your first deposit is matched 100% and your second 50% when you load a game. There is nothing after the second, and there are no promo codes.
  • Redeem has a threshold and a cap. A redeem opens when the in-game balance reaches 3x the load, and total redeems on a load are capped at 8x. A $20 load opens redeem at $60 in the game and caps at $160.
  • Every redeem is reviewed. You need an approved government ID, and a staff member reviews the request. Casinova does not promise a payout time. See how to redeem.

What is not published

The game providers do not publish odds or RTP figures for these apps, and Casinova does not control or publish them either. If you see a payout percentage quoted for Juwa or Game Vault somewhere online, it did not come from the provider. Outcomes are based on chance, and no pattern or strategy changes that. The safety checklist explains what you can and cannot verify about a game.

Which one suits you

This is not a case of one being better. If a regulator's oversight, a formal complaints route and published game information matter most to you, a licensed operator in a place where one is available is the fit, and Casinova is not a substitute for that. If you are specifically looking for app-style games such as Juwa or Game Vault behind one card-funded wallet with fixed load and redeem rules, that is what Casinova provides.

Either way, the same habits apply: decide your budget before you deposit, treat the money as spent on entertainment, and stop when it is gone. The responsible play page lists tools and help lines.

FAQ

Is Casinova Gaming a real online casino?

No. It is a sweepstakes gaming platform and does not hold a casino license.

Can I use Casinova where I live?

Availability varies by jurisdiction and Casinova makes no legality claim for any location. Check the rules that apply to you before signing up. Players must be 18 or older.

Do the games publish RTP like some casino games do?

No. The providers do not publish odds or RTP for these apps, and Casinova does not either.

Is redeeming the same as a casino withdrawal?

Not quite. You redeem from the game panel once the in-game balance is at least 3x your load, up to an 8x cap, with an approved ID and a staff review. There is no promised payout time.

Which payment methods does Casinova accept?

Card only, through a payment partner. No other method is offered.

Create your free account and read the deposit and redeem screens yourself before you spend anything.

title: Casinova XP and Levels Explained: VIP Points and Tiers
excerpt: Casinova Gaming does not have XP or numbered levels. Progress is measured in VIP points, and those points place you in one of four tiers: Bronze at 0, Silver at 500, Gold at 2,000 and Platinum at 5,000. Points come from card deposits, daily check-ins, the daily spin, completed game account requests and referrals.
content:
Casinova Gaming does not have XP or numbered levels. Progress is measured in VIP points, and those points place you in one of four tiers: Bronze at 0, Silver at 500, Gold at 2,000 and Platinum at 5,000. Points come from card deposits, daily check-ins, the daily spin, completed game account requests and referrals.

XP versus VIP points

If you searched for a Casinova XP curve or a level chart, there is not one. An earlier version of this page described an XP formula, level milestones and coin bonuses that the site does not have. The only progress number on your account is your VIP points total, and the only "levels" are the four VIP tiers. Everything below describes that system.

The four tiers

TierPoints neededReferral shareDaily spins
Bronze05%1
Silver50010%2
Gold2,00015%3
Platinum5,00025%3

The referral share is a percentage of a referred friend's first deposit, credited to you. Daily spins are per 24 hours. The VIP tiers guide covers the support benefits attached to each tier, and the VIP page shows the same table.

Where points come from

ActionVIP points
Card deposit credited to your wallet1 point per dollar, rounded to the nearest whole point
Daily check-in on the Daily rewards page5 on the first day, 1 more for each consecutive day, up to 11 from day seven
Daily mission: spin the wheel, then claim5
Cash prize on the daily spin10 points per dollar won, so 10 to 100
Game account request completed by staff50
Friend signs up with your referral code10

A few details behind the table:

  • Deposits. Points are added when a card deposit is credited to your wallet. A $25 deposit is 25 points.
  • Check-in streak. The Daily rewards page in your dashboard has a claim button. Day one pays 5 points, day two 6, and so on up to 11 on day seven and every day after. The day is counted in UTC. Miss one and the streak goes back to 5.
  • Daily mission. After you take your daily spin, return to Daily rewards and claim 5 more points. One claim per day.
  • Spin prizes. The wheel pays $1, $2, $3, $4, $7 or $10, or nothing. A cash prize also adds 10 points per dollar, so a $3 result is 30 points. The daily spin guide explains the wheel.
  • Game account requests. When a game account request is completed for you, 50 points are added.
  • Referrals. 10 points for each friend who signs up with your code. See the referral guide.

How long does Silver take?

Silver is 500 points. Here is the arithmetic for a member who never deposits and never refers anyone, using the check-in and the mission only:

  • First seven days of check-ins: 5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + 9 + 10 + 11 = 56 points.
  • Seven daily missions: 35 points. First week total: 91.
  • Each day after that: 11 for the check-in plus 5 for the mission, 16 points.

At Casinova Gaming, fish games sit inside live apps such as Juwa, Game Vault and Vegas Sweeps. Two ideas in one phrase

"Fish table sweepstakes" joins a game format and a platform model, and it helps to separate them.

  • Fish table is the format. Players share a screen full of moving fish. Each shot costs credits at the bet you choose, and a fish that is caught pays credits back. The name comes from the arcade cabinets built as a table with seats around it. What is a fish table game explains the format on its own.
  • Sweepstakes is the model the platform operates under. It is a different category from a licensed casino. What are sweepstakes games covers the model in plain terms.

One caution on the second point: a sweepstakes model is not the same as being permitted everywhere. Availability varies by jurisdiction, Casinova makes no claim about any location, and checking the rules where you live is up to you.

How a fish table round works

  1. You pick a room, usually sorted by stake.
  2. You set a bet per shot. Higher bets cost more per shot and pay more per catch.
  3. You aim and fire. Small fish take fewer hits and pay less; larger targets take more and pay more.
  4. Whether a shot catches a fish is decided by the game's software. It is chance, not marksmanship.

That last step is the one people misread. Aiming well stops you wasting shots on empty water, but it does not change the odds on any single hit. The providers do not publish odds or RTP for these games, and no timing trick or pattern makes a catch certain. What you do control is the bet per shot and how long you stay, which is why honest advice about fish tables is mostly about pacing. The fish table versus slots comparison shows how quickly each format uses a balance.

Take a $20 load. Redeem opens when the game balance shows $60 and the cap is $160. Knowing the two numbers before you start tells you when to stop: once you are above the threshold, every further shot is a choice to risk a redeemable balance.

Session habits that matter more than aim

  • Start at the lowest bet per shot. Fish tables can use credits fast because you can fire many shots a minute.
  • Decide the load before you open the app and do not top up mid-session.
  • Do not chase one large target. A big fish that has taken many shots is not "due". Each shot is independent.
  • Set a time limit. Shared rooms keep going after you leave.

New players may prefer to learn the panel on a slower format first; the beginner ranking explains why. Play is for adults 18 and over, and the responsible play page is there if a session stops being fun.
